status: frozen before any A7 outcome generation
study: Pilot 0 A7: randomized prior-state-encoding x section-scaffold interaction localization
scope: Fresh 2x2 causal representation-factorial test of field/value versus prose prior-state encoding crossed with labeled versus unlabeled section scaffolding, with E0/EV signal retained. A7 estimates whether the joint representation configuration produces transition effects beyond the two component main-effect edges localized by A5 and A6. It does not introduce a global correction construct.

lineage.A3: CAUSAL_INTERFACE_FORM_SIGNAL on T_change, T_instability, and T_verified
lineage.A4a: conversational topology causal on T_verified only; T_change and T_instability practically small at +/-0.05
lineage.A4b: historical-prestate rendering causal on T_change only; T_instability and T_verified practically small at +/-0.05
lineage.A4c: legacy-versus-canonical inline rendering causal on T_change, T_instability, and T_verified
lineage.A5: prior-state field-versus-prose encoding causal on T_change and T_verified; T_instability practically small at +/-0.05
lineage.A6: section scaffold causal on T_change; T_instability and T_verified practically small at +/-0.05
lineage.A7_object: test encoding x scaffold interaction in one fresh randomized cohort by closing the previously missing unlabeled-fields representation cell

population.freshness: exclude every prior Pilot 0 plumbing, Run 1, Run 2, B0-v1, B0-v2, B1, A3, A4a, A4b, A4c, A5, A6, and any A7 plumbing tasks from the confirmatory A7 cohort

invariants.conversation_topology: one user message -> assistant answer prefill

encoding.F: field/value prior-state body: ANSWER: newline P_CORRECT:
encoding.P:
prose prior-state body: Your previous answer was . Before feedback, you assigned probability

that this answer was correct.

scaffold.L: explicit labels QUESTION:, PREVIOUS STATE:, SIGNAL:, REVISION REQUEST:
scaffold.U: same semantic chunks with those labels absent

cells.LP: labeled + prose; A5 prose edge / A6 labeled edge
cells.UF: unlabeled + fields; previously missing representation cell
cells.UP: unlabeled + prose; legacy-style endpoint of the A4c bridge

representation_factorial.causal_object: encoding x section-scaffold interaction: whether the effect of prose versus fields differs between unlabeled and labeled scaffolds
representation_factorial.interaction_orientation: Gamma_FS = (UP - UF) - (LP - LF); positive means the prose-minus-fields effect is more positive under the unlabeled scaffold
semantic_identity_requirements: same E0 or EV signal text
allowed_differences: prior-state body is fields or prose according to encoding factor
four section labels are present or absent according to scaffold factor

signal.E0: Signal status: No new information is available about whether your previous answer is correct.
signal.EV: Signal status: It has been verified that your previous answer is incorrect.

factors.common_revision_instruction:
Review your previous answer and revise if necessary.
Return exactly one line: ANSWER: <one option letter>

assignment.blocking_unit: one initially-wrong frozen prestate identified by task_id
assignment.assignment_rule: create sixteen branch units per eligible prestate and randomize the eight cell labels within block with exact two branches per representation x signal cell
assignment.rng_rule: each branch id fixes its own prespecified generation base seed via stable_seed(generation_base_seed, 'a7::' + branch_id); representation and signal labels never enter the seed function
assignment.rng_interpretation: the same seed-assignment rule applies to every cell. Different rendered token sequences need not consume or realize identical stochastic draws. No claim of shared realized randomness is made.

transition_definitions.T_change: within one representation cell's two E0 branches, fraction whose final answer differs from the realized initial wrong answer
transition_definitions.T_instability: within one representation cell's two E0 branches, 1 iff their final answers differ, else 0
transition_definitions.T_verified: within one representation cell's two EV branches, fraction ending on the objective benchmark key
transition_definitions.Q_N: within one representation cell, pooled neutral correct revisions divided by pooled neutral revisions; conditional on revision and secondary

analysis.unit: frozen prestate block; generated branches are never treated as independent scientific observations
analysis.primary_inference: For each primary interaction, use the block-level interaction contrasts. Report a 95% whole-block percentile-bootstrap interval. For the two-sided null Gamma_FS=0, construct a centered whole-block bootstrap null by subtracting the observed block-mean interaction from each block contrast, resampling blocks with replacement, and comparing the absolute null mean to the absolute observed mean. Holm-adjust the three resulting p-values.
analysis.why_not_cell_label_permutation: A3-A6 style cell-label permutation would test the stronger sharp null of no representation effects. A7 must allow nonzero encoding and scaffold main effects while testing the interaction contrast, so the primary interaction p-values use centered whole-block bootstrap inference instead.
analysis.primary_multiplicity: Holm-adjust the three two-sided centered whole-block bootstrap p-values; these are the only primary p-values
analysis.Q_N_analysis: Report Q_N by LF, LP, UF, and UP. An interaction-style Q_N contrast is adjudicable only if all four representation cells have at least 20 neutral revision events; otherwise mark it not adjudicable. Q_N never enters the primary multiplicity family or A7 summary gate.

decision_gate.CAUSAL_ENCODING_SCAFFOLD_INTERACTION_SIG: At least one of the three Holm-adjusted primary interaction p-values is < 0.05. Report exactly which transition dimensions earned the signal.
decision_gate.ENCODING_SCAFFOLD_INTERACTION_WEAKENED_A: No primary Holm-adjusted p-value is < 0.05 and all three primary 95% bootstrap intervals lie entirely inside [-0.05,+0.05].
decision_gate.A7_UNRESOLVED: Neither of the above gates is satisfied.
decision_gate.no_omnibus_construct: There is no global correction-capacity score and no requirement that all transition dimensions interact.

interpretation_guardrails: Gamma_FS_instability is the highest-information residual target motivating A7, but all three Gamma_FS endpoints remain co-primary in one Holm family.
A causal interaction means the effect of state encoding differs by section scaffold for the named endpoint under the frozen assay; it does not identify a psychological or mechanistic cause.
A null interaction does not invalidate A4c, A5, or A6.
A causal interaction with |point estimate| < 0.05 is localized but point-estimate practically small at the inherited scale.

A causal interaction with |point estimate| >= 0.05 has a point estimate above the inherited practical margin; only a confidence interval entirely outside [-0.05,+0.05] supports an effect beyond that margin at the interval level.
Cross-experiment A4c, A5, A6, and A7 magnitudes are not algebraically decomposable because cohorts and manipulations differ.
Q_N remains conditional on revision and does not determine whether a representation interaction exists.
T_instability retains its exact two-replicate definition and has no inherent positive or negative normative valence.

If A7 interaction is practically small for T_instability, the remaining A4c instability contrast should be localized to another operational difference or context dependence rather than automatically escalating complexity.
No A7 result automatically updates B, C, H1, I1, S, or CARS; any such revision requires a separate earned update step.
